subject: Re: POC next steps & deployment mode decision — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bethany Smith <bethany.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC next steps & deployment mode decision — Acme Health

Thanks again for your time today, Bethany — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the PoC approach and deployment mode (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem):

Recap from call
- Primary use case: clinical note summarization + PHI-aware redaction and embedding for downstream search.
- Key success criteria discussed: latency (<200ms per request at 95th percentile), throughput (sustained 10 RPS during peak test), output quality (ROUGE/clinician sign-off on 3 sample flows), and compliance requirements (PHI handling, audit logs, data residency).
- Stakeholders: Bethany Smith (Head of Data), Dr. Michael Allen (CTO), Carlos Reyes (Security).

Questions we need to confirm from your side
1) Is PHI actively present in the dataset for the PoC, or will you provide de-identified data?
2) Any hard constraints that mandate an on-prem install vs VPC vs a dedicated cloud environment?
3) Preferred kickoff window and target PoC duration (we budget 4–8 weeks depending on scope).

Proposed technical plan (initial recommendation)
- Rapid evaluation: start with Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) for a 3-week functional/latency evaluation using a production-like dataset (can be anonymized). This reduces setup time and lets us validate latency/throughput quickly.
- If PHI or regulatory constraints require it, plan parallel work for Private VPC (customer-controlled network) to transition for the full PoC — estimated additional 2–3 weeks to provision and onboard.
- Hosted API is an option for non-PHI test traffic but not recommended for PHI-sensitive data.

POC mutual action items I can own
- Draft mutual action plan + SOW and share by Wed (attached: Acme-POC-MAP.pdf).
- Coordinate engineering kickoff (we'll need a security contact + network contact for VPN/SFTP/SSH access if moving to VPC).
- Provide an estimate for Dedicated resource sizing and expected cost for the trial.

Next steps
- Please confirm answers to the three questions above and whether you prefer to start with Dedicated or wait for Private VPC provisioning.
- If you confirm Dedicated-first, can we schedule a technical kickoff on Tue 2026-03-09?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a proposed mutual action plan and a short cost estimate once I have your confirmation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Acme-POC-MAP.pdf (2 pages, Mutual Action Plan stub)

From: Bethany Smith <bethany.smith@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Carlos Reyes <c.reyes@acmehealth.com>, Dr. Michael Allen <m.allen@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 16:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC next steps & deployment mode decision — Acme Health

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. Quick answers below:

1) PHI: Yes, the production dataset contains PHI. We can provide a de-identified subset for initial validation, but to fully validate redaction and auditability we will need to run against PHI in a controlled environment.
2) Must-have constraints: data cannot leave our VPC for PHI workloads; audit logs and key management must meet our security checklist. If Private VPC/add-on on-prem is required, we'll prioritize that for the full PoC. That said, we are open to a short Dedicated trial if Redwood can guarantee no PHI leaves our network and we can control keys/integrations.
3) Timeline: target 6–8 week PoC end-to-end. We're hoping to start the week of 2026-03-08.

Stakeholders and next steps:
- Security lead: Carlos Reyes (cc'd) — Carlos can provide our detailed checklist and will need to review any SOC2 / penetration test artifacts. (I've attached the initial security requirements doc we referenced.)
- Technical kickoff: Tue 2026-03-09 works for me. Please share the MAP and a draft SOW ahead of the call.

Also need: a cost ballpark for the Dedicated trial and an estimate for Private VPC onboarding time/costs.

Best,
Bethany
Head of Data, Acme Health
bethany.smith@acmehealth.com
Attachment: security_requirements.pdf (6 pages)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC next steps & deployment mode decision — Acme Health

Nice recap — a few technical clarifications and a proposed minimal plan from eng/SRE perspective.

Assumptions:
- PHI will be used during the full PoC, so any env handling PHI must meet customer KMS/audit requirements.
- For a rapid first phase we can run a Dedicated environment in the customer's preferred cloud region (we can require VPC peering and customer-managed KMS to satisfy some controls). This still sits on Redwood-managed infra but with network controls.

Proposed two-phase approach (recommended):
Phase A — Rapid Dedicated trial (3 weeks)
- Objective: validate latency/throughput and model quality using a production-like (preferably de-identified) dataset.
- Resources: 2 x A100-equivalent GPUs (Dedicated pool), 1 Redwood SE + 1 SRE for onboarding, sample trace capture for latency analysis.
- Success metrics: 95th pctl latency < 200ms, sustained 10 RPS, pass clinical quality checks on 3 flows.
- Access needed: SFTP for data ingest or access to de-identified dataset; temporary service account + IP allowlist; optional KMS integration for key-in-transit. Estimated effort: 5 workdays for setup.

Phase B — Private VPC onboarding (if PHI required)
- Objective: full-PoC in customer-controlled network with KMS and retained audit logs.
- Resources: Private control plane + customer VPC peering, infra provisioning ~2–3 weeks, dedicated SRE support during cutover.
- Success metrics: same as Phase A + attestations for KMS/key ownership, audit logs and penetration test review.

Deliverables we can prepare before the kickoff:
- Mutual Action Plan + SOW (Marissa to send).
- An engineer-run sizing/cost estimate for the Dedicated trial (I can produce an initial spreadsheet).
- Onboarding checklist for Private VPC (network requirements, IP ranges, service accounts, expected ports).

I'll draft the Dedicated trial cost estimate and the Private VPC onboarding checklist by EOD Wed. If Marissa wants, I can join the 3/9 kickoff to walk through technical requirements.

— Vivek
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

From: Bethany Smith <bethany.smith@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: POC next steps & deployment mode decision — Acme Health

Sounds good — we agree to start with the Dedicated trial as Phase A to validate performance and model behavior. Conditional on the results and security review, we'll onboard Private VPC for PHI workloads (Phase B).

Confirming: kickoff Tue 2026-03-09 at 10:00am PT. Please share the mutual action plan and a draft SOW in advance (we need to circulate to legal and security). Also include the Dedicated trial cost estimate and the Private VPC provisioning timeline.

I'll have Carlos share the security checklist with Marissa and Vivek prior to the call. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Thanks,
Bethany
Head of Data, Acme Health
